[P2] Establish evidence for the engine-specific lexical assumptions

Rule 6, “Mark unverified assumptions,” requires evidence for external behavior or an explicit unverified designation. These exemptions depend on Athena and DynamoDB tokenizing backslashes as assumed, but the description reports real-engine checks only for PostgreSQL. The new allow-tests exercise this validator, so they cannot establish agreement with either database. Return to the design phase under Rule 8 and document evidence for these assumptions, or mark them unverified for a maintainer decision.
